allocation.V09_note: Parallel critics occupy400 total and one family slot each; treatment critical path400, no free extra work.

candidate_authorship: All substantive scored candidate checking, integration and code remain affordable candidate-native Goal work; Sol only scenario/protocol/evaluator infrastructure.
control: One fresh critic handles the whole evidence/coverage/derivation review.

execution_policy.factor_enforcement: V01 control critic physically lacks execution, not only text prohibition; otherwise tools equal unless documented factor is retrieval ordering/representation.

family_binding_rule: Within pair identical actual supported family/model/effort. Root may version an unstarted card prospectively if route unavailable; preserve original planned family and reason. No substitution attributed as same-model replication.
fixture_prerequisites: Freeze an authentic affordable-candidate unscored development seed appropriate to this task, with complete relevant source captures. Do not have Sol write candidate findings or a source-answer key.
Independent fixture-admission evaluator verifies task suitability/source versions and any required mix privately; candidate receives no truth labels or corrected answers.
Record seed provenance, actual candidate model/native job, creation cost and SHA-256; seed is development input, never scored arm completion.

important_checks.question: Do the same predeclared consequential source/behavior claims receive correct supported correction or preservation under this method, without a new consequential error?
Does the final retain supported conditions, legitimate uncertainty and required useful content rather than blanket rejection or incomplete delivery?
Was the declared mechanism actually taken up with honest source/execution scope, and what critical/false-rejection/repair differences appear under matched budgets?

integration_limit: Both critics consume this campaign's family slots and the pipeline's total budget. A recipe requiring two concurrent Goals on one account must disclose that requirement.
measure: Critical-path latency, aggregate occupied time, duplicate work, disagreement quality, coverage seams and final corrections. No majority-vote truth rule.
question: Include cross-boundary errors so splitting cannot earn credit just by ignoring interactions. Both critics have the brief and sufficient common context.
source_scope: Both treatment critics receive exact brief/full proposal; source-applicability and implementation/derivation scopes overlap on cross-boundary dependencies.
task: Use a candidate report containing an error crossing source coordinate conventions and actual export implementation, plus supported unrelated claims. Both complementary critics need common context; candidate resolves evidence, not votes.
treatment: Split a fixed critic budget between two fresh same-family critics with complementary, overlapping responsibilities, such as source applicability and implementation/derivation behavior. The candidate resolves both into one result.
